O controle clássico parte de um modelo s: Classical control starts from a simplified model of the body: the zero moment point (ZMP) must stay inside the support polygon of the feet, or centroidal dynamics (total mass and momentum) predicts the motion. The support polygon is covered in course 0, lesson 6.
O controle preditivo (MPC) resolve, a ca: Model predictive control (MPC) solves, on every cycle, an optimization over the next few moments using the model. It is interpretable and gives guarantees about the model, but each new behavior calls for new engineering.
A Figure relatou que o Helix 02 (27/01/2: Figure reported that Helix 02 (01/27/2026) replaced 109,504 lines of control C++ with a learned whole-body controller, running at 1 kHz, with 10 M parameters. The course's research found no independent MPC × RL comparison published in 2026.
Em vez de escrever a física do passo, ro: Instead of writing the physics of the step, you run the robot in thousands of parallel copies in the simulator (Isaac Lab, mjlab, MuJoCo Playground), and an RL algorithm (PPO) tunes the network using the reward. legged_gym (Isaac Gym, 2021) is the predecessor, now legacy.
O resultado é uma rede pequena: lê a vel: The result is a small network: it reads the angular velocity, gravity in the body frame, the command, the joints and the last action, and returns 29 joint targets every 20 ms. This is the one you run in this lesson.
Os alvos nêo viram torque direto: um con: The targets don't become torque directly: a PD controller on each joint, much faster than the policy, turns each target into torque. This is the lower layer, the topic of lesson 2.
MPC segue vivo como conceito e onde se e: MPC lives on as a concept and wherever a guarantee is required. The practice in this course is the right-hand column: simulation, policy and PD.

A política manda a posiçêo desejada da j: The policy sends the desired joint position (in radians) every 20 ms: default pose + 0.25 × action, as in unitree_rl_lab.
O encoder lê a posiçêo atual q. O termo: The encoder reads the current position q. The P term multiplies the error by kp: the farther from the target, the more torque.
O termo D subtrai kd × velocidade da jun: The D term subtracts kd × joint velocity: it's a brake that keeps the joint from overshooting the target and oscillating. Without it, the joint is a spring.
O motor nêo entrega qualquer torque: o M: The motor doesn't deliver just any torque: the Menagerie MJCF limits each joint (actuatorfrcrange). A request above the limit gets clipped, and then the PD stops being linear. Actuators are covered in course 0, lesson 4.
No kit, o MuJoCo integra a 500 Hz com o: In the kit, MuJoCo integrates at 500 Hz with the PD inside the position actuator. On the robot, the PD runs in the motor driver, even faster; course 2 measures the delay between the two.
Nêo há termo I: o PID completo com integ: There's no I term: the full PID with integral and classic tuning is a topic for the robot course. In RL robots, the policy corrects the error that's left over.
